summary.es: Joseph Drouhin Santenay es un vino tinto de Maison Joseph Drouhin, con la denominación AOC Santenay, en Francia.

body.en:
It is made from Pinot Noir. It is aged in wood. It has 13% ABV.

Family-owned Beaune house founded in 1880, with its own vineyards in Chablis, the Côte de Nuits and the Côte de Beaune, and an offshoot in Oregon.
